snippet.title: Rescue: The Embassy Mission (NES) Playthrough - NintendoComplete
snippet.description:
A playthrough of Kemco's 1990 NES game, Rescue: The Embassy Mission. For the review, complete with screenshot gallery and soundtrack, be sure to check out http://www.nintendocomplete.com/rescue-the-embassy-mission/

Played through the game on Commander mode, mission Jupiter (hardest settings). The mission doesn't change the game in any major ways - all of the missions are the same except for the time given to complete it and the number of people you have to kill. 

It's an amazing game for sure. It would just have been a lot better if it felt like a full game and not a demo. I would have been annoyed as a kid had I gotten this as a gift, because this really doesn't (nor did it back then) justify a full-price price tag. 

______
No cheats were used during the recording of this video.
